items.text: Unplayable game. Every mechanic is obnoxiously obtuse, I spend over half a hour trying to install a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ battery charger with it in my inventory and the game keeps saying missing item.
items.text_zh: 没法玩的游戏。每个机制都令人恼火地晦涩难懂，我花了半个多小时试图安装一个♥♥♥♥♥♥♥电池充电器，它就在我的物品栏里，游戏却一直说缺少物品。

observations.description: 尝试安装电池充电器时，游戏一直提示缺少物品
